Free access (keyless) returns current gauge value and band; Plus plans add component details (reading, rank, score) and historical data (1h or 24h intervals with start/end times); Pro plans add all coins ranked. Free access (keyless) returns current gauge value and band; Plus plans add component details (reading, rank, score) and historical data (1h or 24h intervals with start/end times); Pro plans add all coins ranked.
